# resolve

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/resolution/deployment/resolve"
```

Package resolve implements resolution for the Deployment CR.

The Deployment CR stores its spec as a raw JSON contract \(spec.contract\). ResolveDeployment decodes this into a fully typed ResolvedDeployment — the authoritative runtime representation consumed by all downstream domain and application logic.

Resolution is strict: required fields that are missing or malformed return errors immediately. All failures surface as errors — resolution never panics.

<a name="ResolvedDeployment"></a>
## type ResolvedDeployment

ResolvedDeployment pairs the original Kubernetes Deployment object with its fully decoded and validated spec.

```go
type ResolvedDeployment struct {
    Deployment *environmentv1alpha1.Deployment
    Spec       *ResolvedDeploymentSpec
}
```

<a name="ResolveDeployment"></a>
### func ResolveDeployment

```go
func ResolveDeployment(depl *environmentv1alpha1.Deployment) (*ResolvedDeployment, error)
```

ResolveDeployment decodes and validates the raw JSON contract from the Deployment CR spec into a ResolvedDeployment. Returns an error if the CR is nil, the contract is absent, or any required field is missing or malformed.
